newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: LUKoil says 1996 net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil says 1996 net profit falls.

text.p: Net profit at Russia's biggest oil company LUKoil fell to 1.30 trillion roubles in 1996 from 2.40 trillion in 1995, on sales of 35 trillion after 29.57 trillion, LUKoil president Vagit Alekperov said on Tuesday.
Alekperov was talking to businessmen in Moldova, where LUKoil opened two filling stations. It plans to open another three filling stations and modernise nine more this year.
He later told reporters the fall in net profit was due to heavy expenditure on investment programmes.
Last month LUKoil said net profit in the first nine months of 1996 was 2.609 trillion roubles, up from 1.197 trillion in the same 1995 period.
It was not immediately clear how the figures could be reconciled.
Alekperov said the state's stake in LUKoil would fall to six from 16 percent this year.
